about: Advice catalogue for the report (docs/24 section 6). One entry per finding id, with per-tool text (claude, codex): 'action' is one plain sentence a person can act on without knowing setting names, 'how' lists the exact command or setting shown after it, 'instruction' is a standing rule that may be copied into an instruction file. Each tool has a basis (official | study | ours | heuristic) and sources with the date read and the exact claim. A copy named advice.json in the settings folder replaces the built-in one; the report flags it when the oldest 'read' date is older than stale_after_days.
